title: Taylor Swift Breaks Streaming Records with New Album
author: BBC / Business Insider
excerpt: Taylor Swift's latest album, 'The Life of a Showgirl', has shattered streaming records on Spotify and grossed millions at a theatrical event.
content:
Taylor Swift's latest album, The Life of a Showgirl, released on October 3, 2025, has shattered streaming records. Within just 11 hours, it became Spotify's most-streamed album in a single day for the year.

The standout track, 'The Fate of Ophelia,' also broke records as the most-streamed song in a single day in the platform's history.

Swift launched a theatrical event in partnership with AMC Theatres, featuring exclusive content like music videos and behind-the-scenes clips. The event grossed nearly $16 million on its first day and is projected to reach up to $30 million over the weekend.

For more details, see the Business Insider article.
